searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md, life/PROFILE.md, life/OUTLOOK.md, profile.md, and data/target-companies.json before hunting. No graduation-date conflict found live in the files (both say December 2026); noted per task instructions anyway. Confirmed the proxy README at /root/.ccr/README.md: a 403/407 or ENOTFOUND on a destination means the host is simply not on this session's allowlist -- not a fixable client-side TLS/config issue, and not something to retry or route around. Independently re-tested the network blocker reported by every run since ~2026-08: WebFetch to job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, jobs.lever.co, jobs.generalcatalyst.com, www.appliedintuition.com, www.palantir.com, www.startupschool.org, and openai.com all failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND. Only www.anthropic.com resolved (fetched anthropic.com/careers/jobs: Applied AI Architect x30+, Forward Deployed Engineer x3 (Munich/Paris/London), 24 Technical Program Manager reqs -- none carry a new-grad/entry-level marker; Anthropic Fellows Program is research-only, not one of the 6 target role families). WebSearch (which does not go through the blocked egress path) surfaced real-looking new-grad Forward Deployed Engineer candidates -- Palantir (Commercial/US Gov variants), Applied Intuition ('Forward Deployed Engineer - New Grad (December 2026)', a strong timeline match), Domino Data Lab, Faros, Raft -- but every one of their actual application/careers pages (Lever, General Catalyst's job board, and the companies' own domains) is also outside the allowlist, so hunt.md's verify-by-fetching rule could not be satisfied for any of them. Including one on a search snippet alone would violate this routine's honesty rules. 0 verified is the correct, honest result.
knownIssue: CONFIRMED AGAIN, independently, 2026-11-20, with a wider domain sample than prior runs (8 hosts: job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, jobs.lever.co, jobs.generalcatalyst.com, www.appliedintuition.com, www.palantir.com, www.startupschool.org, openai.com -- all getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). Only www.anthropic.com resolves via WebFetch. This is a session-level network egress allowlist, not a per-tool fix (see /root/.ccr/README.md: '403/407 ... do not retry or route around it -- report the blocked host'). WebSearch itself works and surfaces real, specific, promising new-grad FDE leads (Palantir, Applied Intuition's Dec-2026 new-grad FDE posting), but none of their application pages can be fetched to verify open/eligible status, so none can be included without breaking the verify-by-fetch rule. This has already been escalated via PushNotification repeatedly on prior runs (per git log, since at least 2026-11-05, ~every day) with no fix landing -- not re-pushing today since nothing about the blocker itself is new, but flagging prominently here again. Fix needed: widen the session/routine's network allowlist to include at minimum greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, generalcatalyst.com, and company-owned career domains.
